env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_label_scopes.lgo good/main.lgo
cd good
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_label_scopes.out
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_label_scopes.out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_label_scopes.out
cd ..
cd ../unused
! logos build .
cd ../undefined
! logos build .
cd ../crosschild
! logos build .
cd ../outward
! logos build .

-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/grouplabelgood

go 1.27
-- unused/go.mod --
module example.com/grouplabelunused

go 1.27
-- unused/main.lgo --
package main
import "context"
func f() error {
 go group (context.Background()) {
  go {
  Unused:
   println("unused")
  }
 }
 return nil
}
func main() {}
-- undefined/go.mod --
module example.com/grouplabelundefined

go 1.27
-- undefined/main.lgo --
package main
import "context"
func f() error {
 go group (context.Background()) {
  go { goto Missing }
 }
 return nil
}
func main() {}
-- crosschild/go.mod --
module example.com/grouplabelcrosschild

go 1.27
-- crosschild/main.lgo --
package main
import "context"
func f() error {
 go group (context.Background()) {
  go { goto Shared }
  go {
   goto Shared
  Shared:
   println("local")
  }
 }
 return nil
}
func main() {}
-- outward/go.mod --
module example.com/grouplabeloutward

go 1.27
-- outward/main.lgo --
package main
import "context"
func f() error {
Outer:
 for {
  go group (context.Background()) {
   go { break Outer }
  }
  break Outer
 }
 return nil
}
func main() {}
